title: Writing Solid Responsive Search Ads | Gravitate

facts.fact: Google's Responsive Search Ads allow advertisers to provide multiple headlines and descriptions that Google mixes and matches.
facts.quote: Google has rolled out Responsive Search Ads, which allows you to provide multiple headlines and descriptions that Google mixes and matches for you.

facts.fact: Each responsive search ad has room for up to 15 headlines and 4 descriptions.
facts.quote: Each responsive search ad has room for up to 15 headlines and 4 descriptions we can fill.

facts.fact: The article's author recommends using as many headlines and descriptions as possible in responsive search ads.
facts.quote: We recommend using as many of these as possible as mentioned above consumers like ads tailored to their interests or habits.

facts.fact: The article states that short and concise calls to action typically perform better within paid search ads.
facts.quote: Short and concise CTAs typically perform better within paid search ads, so it is important to be mindful as you draft copy.

facts.fact: The article's publication date is April 28, 2022.
